description: Transform your date and time data into highly interactive, beautifully designed calendars. Whether you are tracking project milestones, marketing campaigns, employee shifts, or financial timelines, the Calendar visual delivers an unparalleled scheduling experience directly within your Power BI reports. Unlike basic calendar visuals, our solution offers an industry-leading 7 different views, allowing your users to seamlessly pivot from a macro yearly overview down to an hourly daily schedule. Key Features 7 Versatile Views: Empower users to visualize timelines their way. Easily switch between Month, Week, Day, List, Year, Quarter, and Semester views. You have full control to enable or disable specific views based on your report's needs. Intelligent Event Mapping: Seamlessly plot single-day or multi-day events. Bind your data to Start Date, End Date, Event Title, and Category. Advanced Interactivity & Drill-through: Drive actionable insights by mapping Detail URLs to your events. Users can click an event to navigate to external systems, ticketing software, or deeper report pages. Rich Tooltips: Add multiple custom Tooltip Fields to display critical event context on hover without cluttering your visual. Custom Work Schedules: Tailor the calendar to your exact business hours.
